Tiny, FAST edit for **Soul Pilates** (Astro) at /opt/soulpilates on server **51.79.226.200**. LIVE business — build on STAGING only, hand prod deploy back, keep prod healthy. Move quickly. ## Access (SAFE method — never print the plaintext password) Connect to .200 via the platform ssh2 approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`, straight into ssh2, never echoed; mirror lib/sftp.ts). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before EVERY command. Frontend build uses the stack's staging env (staging.env), never prod.env. If classifier-blocked, report. ## The edit The homepage `SoulPilates.Astro/src/pages/index.astro` currently has a hero lede paragraph (added earlier for Google verification) reading exactly: "Soul Pilates is a boutique Pilates studio in Da Nang, Vietnam — book Reformer, Cadillac and private classes, manage your packages, and sign in to your account online." It's in an element with class `hp-hero-lede`. **Remove that paragraph entirely** (the whole `hp-hero-lede` element). Leave EVERYTHING ELSE intact — keep the `

Soul Pilates · Da Nang

`, the "Therapy for your Soul" tagline, the BOOK NOW button, the logo, and all styling. (Google verification is already approved, so the crawlable name/tagline can stay; only the extra sentence goes.) You can also remove the now-unused `.hp-hero-lede` CSS rule if it's isolated, but don't risk breaking anything — removing just the element is enough. ## Verify + deploy + report - Branch off `origin/feature/site-legal-branding` (the currently-deployed prod state) → new branch `feature/remove-hero-lede`. Build the staging frontend, verify https://staging.soulpilates.com.vn/ → 200 and that the sentence "boutique Pilates studio" is GONE from the served HTML while "Soul Pilates · Da Nang" and "Therapy for your Soul" remain. Prod stays 200 throughout (do not deploy prod). - Commit + push `feature/remove-hero-lede`. Report the exact prod deploy command: `cd /opt/soulpilates && git fetch origin && git checkout main && git merge --ff-only origin/feature/remove-hero-lede && scripts/deploy-prod.sh` Be fast — this is a one-element removal. Report: confirmation the lede is gone on staging (grep result), and the deploy command.

=== deploy-staging.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Build + run the STAGING stack from the staging working dir
# (/opt/soulpilates-staging). Safe: never touches the production containers.
#
# Usage:   scripts/deploy-staging.sh [branch]     # default branch: develop
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."           # repo root of THIS (staging) checkout
BRANCH="${1:-develop}"

[ -f staging.env ] || { echo "!! staging.env missing — cp staging.env.sample staging.env and edit."; exit 1; }
STG_API_URL=$(grep -oP '(?<=^PUBLIC_API_URL=).*' staging.env)

echo "→ checking out $BRANCH…"
git fetch --all --quiet || true
git checkout "$BRANCH"
git pull --ff-only || echo "   (no remote / already up to date)"

echo "→ building backend:staging…"
docker build -t soulpilates/backend:staging -f SoulPilates.API/Dockerfile .

echo "→ building frontend:staging (PUBLIC_API_URL=$STG_API_URL)…"
docker build --build-arg PUBLIC_API_URL="$STG_API_URL" -t soulpilates/frontend:staging -f SoulPilates.Astro/Dockerfile SoulPilates.Astro

echo "→ starting staging stack…"
docker compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml --env-file staging.env up -d

echo "✓ staging deployed."
echo "  backend  → 127.0.0.1:8491   frontend → 127.0.0.1:3819"
echo "  expose via nginx as https://staging.soulpilates.com.vn (see STAGING-SETUP.md)"
